mapper.select: SELECT id, name, priority, respond_minutes, resolve_minutes, warn_percent, escalate_role, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM sla_policy WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY priority ASC
SELECT id, name, priority, respond_minutes, resolve_minutes, warn_percent, escalate_role, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM sla_policy WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, name, priority, respond_minutes, resolve_minutes, warn_percent, escalate_role, enabled, create_time, update_time FROM sla_policy WHERE priority = #{priority} AND enabled = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sla_policy (name, priority, respond_minutes, resolve_minutes, warn_percent, escalate_role, enabled) VALUES (#{name}, #{priority}, #{respondMinutes}, #{resolveMinutes}, #{warnPercent}, #{escalateRole}, 1)
mapper.update:
UPDATE sla_policy
name = #{name}, priority = #{priority}, respond_minutes = #{respondMinutes}, resolve_minutes = #{resolveMinutes}, warn_percent = #{warnPercent}, escalate_role = #{escalateRole}, enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sla_policy SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
